chapter.verse: Tua ciangin kuang-uk sagih a nei vanmi sagihte khat kei' kiang hong pai a, “Hong pai in, tui tampite tunga tu numei kizuak miliannu' thuak ding thukhenna kong lak ding hi.
Leitung kumpite in tua numei tawh nulepa tatkhialhna bawl uh a, nulepa tatkhialhna lengtui dawnin leitunga teengte am khinta uh hi,” hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin vanmi in gamgawtak sungah Kha tawh hong paikhiatpih a, daisakna min tawh a kidim sapi a san khat' tunga tu numei khat ka mu hi.

Numeinu in puan a sanduma leh a san silhin kham, suangmanpha leh kep tawh kizem hi. A muhthadahhuai thute leh ama' bawl nulepa tatkhialhna tawh kisai a sianglo thute tawh a kidim kham hai khat a khut ah tawi hi.
A tal tungah thusim a nei min khat kigelh a, “Babylon khuapi lian, numei kizuakte leh leitunga om a muhthadahhuai thute' tunnu,” kici hi.
Tua ciangin mi siangthote' sisan leh Jesu' thu teci pangte' sisan dawnin zukham a bang numeinu ka mu hi. Tua numeinu ka muh ciangin nakpi-in lamdang ka sa hi.
Ahih hangin vanmi in hih bangin hong hopih hi: “Bang hangin lamdang sa na hi hiam? Numeinu' thusim hitaleh, amah a paipih lutang sagih leh sakic sawm a nei sapi' thusim hitaleh, kong gen ding hi.

Na muhkhak sapi pen a om ngeisa, tu laitakin a omlo, leihawmpi sungpan hong thoto kuan, kisiatna a tuak kuan ahi hi. Sapi pen a om ngeisa, tu laitakin a omlo, a hong pai ding ahih manin sapi a muh uh ciangin leitunga teengte' lakah leitung kilamkip ma-a nuntakna laibu sunga min a kikhum lote in lamdang sa ding uh hi.
(Hih thu ah pilna tawh kidim lungsim kisam hi.) Lutang sagih cih pen numeinu' tutna mual sagihte hi a, kumpi sagihte cihna zong ahi hi.
Amau teng lakah nga a puk khin, tu laitakin khat a om, a dang khat hong tung nailo, ahi hi. Hong tun ciangin zong tawmvei sung bek mah omkip ding hi.
A om ngeisa, tu laitaka a omlo ahi sapi tawh kisai-in amah pen a giatna hi a, hinapi sagihte tawh amah kipawl ahih manin kisiatna lam mah manawh hi.
Saki sawm na muhte pen kumpigam a ngah nailo kumpi sawmte hi a, amau pen sapi tawh nai khat sung kumpi bangin uktheihna thu a ngahkhawm ding uh ahi hi.
Tua kumpite kithukhat uh a, sapi' tungah amau' vangliatna leh uktheihna thu ap uh hi.
Tuuno tawh gal kido ding uh a, Tuuno in amaute zo ding hi. Banghanghiam cihleh Tuuno pen topate' Topa leh kumpite' Kumpi hi a, ama' kianga omte pen sapkhiatte, teeltuamte leh ciamkipte ahi uh hi.”
Tua vanmi mah in hih bangin hong gen hi: “Numei kizuaknu' tutna ahi tui tampi na muhte pen tualmite, mihonpite, khualmite leh kampautedahi uh hi.
Saki sawm na muhte, amau teng leh sapi in numei kizuaknu mudah ding uh hi. Tua teng in numei kizuaknu guaksuaksakin guaktangin koih ding uh a, a sa ne-in mei tawh amah haltum ding uh hi.
A hang pen Pasian in ama' ngimna thu a semkhia dingin amaute' lungsim sungah tua thu guang khin a, Pasian' thugente a tangtun mateng amaute a lungsim uh kikhatin sapi' tungah amau' kumpigam ap uh hi.
Numei na muhnu pen leitung kumpite' tungah ukna a nei khuapi lian ahi hi.”
